# Drygate Brewery Color Palettes

<!-- ![](rushmore.jpg) -->

This is an R color palette of one of my favorite breweries: Drygate Brewing Co. from Glasgow, Scotland: https://www.drygate.com. Excellent in taste *and* labels.

Credits go to Karthik Ram and his [Wes Anderson color palette package](https://github.com/karthik/wesanderson) for inspiration and code. 


## Installation

```r
install.packages("")
```
  
__The development version__

```r
devtools::install_github("MAClaassen/drygatebrewer")
```

## Usage

```{r, palettes_dummy}
library("drygatebrewer")
# See all palettes
names(drygate_palettes)
```

## Palettes

### Example uses

```{r, fig_ex_disco, fig.height = 3}
library("ggplot2")
ggplot(diamonds, aes(cut, fill = cut)) +
  geom_bar() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = drygate_palette("CloudCity")) +
  labs(x = "Cut", y = "Count", fill = "Cut")

# pick specific colors
mpg$drivetrain <- factor(mpg$drv, levels = c("f", "r", "4"),
                          labels = c("Front-wheel", "Rear-wheel", "4-wheel"))
pal <- drygate_palette("Drygate")[c(1, 4, 6)]
ggplot(mpg, aes(drivetrain, fill = drivetrain)) +
  geom_bar() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
  labs(x = "Drivetrain", y = "Count", fill = "Drivetrain")
```

```{r, fig_ex_river, fig.height = 3}
pal <- drygate_palette("TakeMeTotheRiver", 21, type = "continuous")
image(volcano, col = pal)
```
